description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for version 5.4.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to set up database tables, insert data, configure system settings, and manage internationalization strings relevant to this migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class manages the database migration for system version 5.4.0, handling schema updates, configuration settings, internationalization, and OAuth2 setup as part of the upgrade process.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration by updating language strings, inserting modules, configuring password policies, setting up OAuth2 tables, and altering existing database schemas.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of this migration, '5.4.0'.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version to the current migration version if not already set.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a LangStringHelper instance used for language string operations.

methods.name: modifyDefaultRequiredPasswordStrength
methods.description: Adjusts the default required password strength setting based on existing configuration values.

methods.name: modifyDefaultPasswordEnforcement
methods.description: Adjusts password enforcement policies based on current configuration.

methods.name: createOAuth2Tables
methods.description: Creates necessary tables for OAuth2 support and inserts initial OAuth2 client configuration, as well as setting encryption keys and token TTL values.

methods.name: changePermissionForAttendanceConfigurationAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the attendance configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForTimeConfigPeriodAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the time sheet configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForEmployeeWorkShiftAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the employee work shift API data group.
